name: Skill Forge
description: Meta skills about skills themselves: author a new SKILL.md from a one-batch clarification, lint an existing one against the repo spec with an exit code CI can gate on, and search/pack/stats this repo from real data. Idea in, compliant shipped skill out.
description_zh: 关于技能本身的元技能三件套：一次性问齐需求后生成合规 SKILL.md（skill-author）、八项静态检查并返回可做 CI 门禁的退出码（skill-linter）、基于真实数据检索技能与装配组合（skill-finder）。想法进、可提交的技能出。
